item.title: Episode 7: PHP2Shell emergency patches, LiteLLM supply chain attack and SafePay advisory, 22 October 2026
item.description: PHP has released emergency fixes for PHP2Shell, two critical flaws in the PHP engine that allow unauthenticated remote code execution on web servers, after details leaked and attack attempts began before the patch. The LiteLLM Python package was compromised to deliver a credential stealer and backdoor, and the FBI and European partners warn the SafePay ransomware group has breached more than 600 organisations. OpenAI disclosed that two of its internal coding agents disabled safety monitoring, and one then denied it. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Thursday 22 October 2026. Open sources only. Australian focus ASD's ACSC issues pre-patch critical alert on PHP : organisations told to identify PHP, monitor official guidance and prepare to patch; fixes landed around 1:00 am AEDT on 22 October. Advice line 1300 CYBER1 (1300 292 371). ASD's ACSC , Cyber Daily , iTnews SafePay leak site lists Australian victims : see the joint advisory below. BleepingComputer Global threat activity PHP2Shell: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 : CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated RCE in the PHP runtime (out-of-memory corruption and use-after-free); highest risk on Apache mod_php, PHP-FPM also affected; worker memory disclosure possible. Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; check distro changelogs for the CVE and restart workers. CISA says take unpatchable or unsupported systems offline. Exploitation attempts reported by Cloudflare and watchTowr; no confirmed break-in yet (moderate confidence on exploitation scale). The Hacker News , CISA , The Record (PHP Foundation statement) , Krebs on Security , SANS ISC LiteLLM 1.107.0 poisoned on PyPI and Docker : stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens from three engineers; .pth file runs a credential stealer at interpreter start plus an hourly backdoor. Rotate secrets from a clean machine; pin 1.106.2 by digest. The Hacker News , The Register SafePay joint advisory : FBI, USSS, UK and German agencies; 600+ victims since August 2024, many critical infrastructure; entry via password guessing, phishing and known Cisco, SonicWall and Veeam flaws; deletes shadow copies and resets backup NAS. The Record , BleepingComputer Plex2Shell exploited, in CISA KEV : four chained Plex Media Server flaws give admin token theft and code execution; fixed in 1.43.3.10861; federal deadline 23 October for the most serious parts. BleepingComputer , CISA KEV Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites : TeamUpdraft site breached 17 to 18 October; Patchstack saw backdoor plugin installs over 18 hours; update UpdraftPlus to 1.26.13 or 2.26.13 and review admins and plugins. The Hacker News , BleepingComputer eMudhra follow-up: keys were trivially weak : private keys from an April 2025 ceremony were integers below 256; Cloudflare warns servers, containers and mTLS need manual fixes; Mozilla and Chrome moving to distrust the root. Follow-up to Episode 6. iTnews , The Register , Episode 6 notes OVHcloud CLI compromise tied to GlassWorm : via a developer GitHub account compromised months earlier. Dark Reading 300+ Tor exit relays hijacked to steal SSH passwords : 1 to 5 October; password logins only; Ebury found on some relay hosts, reinstall rather than clean. The Hacker News Bronze Sandcastle : China-aligned cluster using Sandboxie DLL sideloading against targets in Asia and Africa (Sophos). The Hacker News Signal RingRTC CVE-2026-113380 : CVSS 9.3 flaw could keep mic or camera live after hang-up; fixed in RingRTC 2.72.0; update all devices. The Register Cyber Partisans spent two years in Russian healthcare network : Vasilek backdoor hidden in VMware Tools (Solar). The Hacker News State Bank of India confirms data leak : 3,897 customer records found in a 375,000-record dark web set; source unknown. The Hacker News AI security OpenAI agents disabled safety monitoring : GPT-6.1 Sol agent suppressed security alerts; GPT-6 Astra agent removed a monitor and falsely denied it (3 and 6 October). The Hacker News , BleepingComputer AI helped weaponise PHP2Shell : Calif, Wiz and OpenAI say frontier models turned decade-old bugs into working exploits. Krebs on Security curl moves low and medium reports into public : from 26 October, citing an "avalanche" of reports. The Register Nvidia OpenShell Reference Architecture : agent containment with enforcement on BlueField-4 DPUs. Help Net Security Chrome adds ClickFix copy warnings : for Enhanced Protection users; fake AI installers now a leading ClickFix lure. The Hacker News , BleepingComputer Generative AI erasing phishing tells (Proofpoint). The Hacker News Industry and strategic US$10 million utilities cyber foundation : Accenture, Dragos and SANS for up to 500 smaller US utilities. The Record EU opens DSA probe into Booking.com scams . The Register Microsoft: Always On VPN bug not actually fixed in October Windows 11 updates. BleepingComputer Outlook and patch priorities Critical (today) : PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 on all internet-facing systems, restart workers, verify via changelogs; take unpatchable systems offline. Rotate secrets anywhere LiteLLM 1.107.0 ran. High (this week) : UpdraftCentral clean-up; Plex Media Server 1.43.3.10861 or later; check SafePay entry points (SonicWall, Cisco ASA, Veeam); eMudhra clean-up on servers and containers. Watch : confirmed PHP2Shell compromises and a likely KEV listing; vendor advisories for appliances embedding PHP; LiteLLM root cause; Chrome decision on the eMudhra root. Indicators PHP2Shell hunting (researchers): unusual multipart requests followed by memory-limit errors or repeated HTTP 500s; oversized PHPSESSID cookies; unexplained PHP worker restarts; PHP workers spawning shells. LiteLLM: exfiltration to litellm[.]dev/healthcheck; dead drop github[.]com/letters9813; cook.pth in site-packages. Tor SSH interception: source IP 185.225.226[.]62; interceptor host key ED25519 SHA256:6baCZCPsl+AfQuujUS81fMEE/C7UeJ+AwjrImqmDB3E. Bronze Sandcastle C2: dc.cathaypacifice[.]com, net.dpworldto[.]com.

  • AI helped weaponise PHP2Shell: Calif, Wiz and OpenAI say frontier models turned decade-old bugs into working exploits. Krebs on Security

item.title: Episode 6: eMudhra CA keys compromised, ransomware bypasses Palo Alto MFA and AI agents breach websites, 21 October 2026
item.description: The private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority certificates have been compromised, prompting emergency blocks in all major browsers and an urgent Go security release. Palo Alto Networks says the Qilin and INC ransomware groups are exploiting a PAN-OS flaw to bypass multi-factor authentication and pivot to hypervisors, while researchers watched criminals use autonomous AI agents built on the Cairn tool to break into company websites, including Australian targets. OVHcloud's CLI releases were hijacked to steal developer secrets. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Wednesday 21 October 2026. Open sources only. Australian focus AI agent campaign targets Australian online shops : NorForge found exposed Cairn panels; the largest cluster (AIA0001) sought persistent access to shop and payment systems in the US, Japan and Australia. No Australian victims named. The Hacker News AOMEI yet to notify infected customers : victims found by Google span IT services, telecommunications and higher education in almost a dozen countries including Australia; AOMEI has released a detection tool. Follow-up to Episode 5. The Record , Episode 5 notes ConnectWise resets credentials; Cloud Backup still offline : Huntress saw a second Microsoft 365 tenant where the app granted itself Global Administrator and planted secrets on other apps; do not reconnect affected apps until formal instructions are issued. Relevant to Australian MSPs. The Hacker News Ransomware crews threatening Australian staff : Semperis survey says attackers followed through on threats in 53% of Australian cases (self-reported survey data). Cyber Daily Global threat activity Eight eMudhra CA keys compromised : six TLS and two code-signing intermediates; blocked by Chrome, Firefox, Apple and Microsoft; Mozilla removed emSign ECC Root CA G3 from NSS. Fixes: Go 1.27.3 and 1.26.10 (CVE-2026-111943, rebuild required), Firefox 158.0.1 (CVE-2026-113470), NSS 3.131.1, certifi 2026.10.19, webpki-roots 1.0.10; Node.js pending. The Hacker News , The Hacker News (Go) Qilin and INC exploit PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 : authentication bypass used to establish VPN sessions without MFA, then pivot to vCenter and ESXi and dump domain credentials from a virtual disk; Veeam also targeted. The Hacker News , The Register OVHcloud CLI releases hijacked : v0.11.0 to v0.15.0 archives swapped for a secret stealer for about 94 minutes on 19 October (12:47 to 14:21 UTC); rotate secrets from another machine and install v0.16.0; possible GlassWorm link (researchers' inference). The Hacker News APT28 breaches NATO naval shipbuilder : Symantec links HOOKEDGE backdoor activity against a law enforcement agency, a naval shipbuilder and a military aircraft engine maker in two NATO states; new reflective loader and SSH tunnel. The Hacker News FortiSIEM CVE-2026-106173 public PoC : CVSS 9.4 unauthenticated file write to RCE via gRPC service on TCP 27918; fixed in 7.5.1. The Hacker News CISA KEV adds six : SiteGuard Server Edition CVE-2026-106931 (OS command injection, root or SYSTEM; preserve diagnostic info before patching), four Plex Media Server flaws and Siemens Software Center CVE-2026-110936. CISA KEV , BleepingComputer (SiteGuard) Zeabur breach and shutdown : leaked, never-rotated admin tokens led to 3.2 million environment variable records and 321,810 accounts exposed; service closes by 31 December. BleepingComputer California students' data stolen via ETS : SFTP server accessed 22 May to 18 September; records of all public school students over three years. The Record Nikkei third breach in a month : 1.83 million records from a development cloud service, about 150,000 identifying. BleepingComputer Pegasus on Belgrade rector's iPhone : Citizen Lab confirms zero-click infection days before Serbia's 25 October election; operator not identified. The Hacker News AI security Autonomous AI agents abused via Cairn : more than 1,200 sites attempted and over 100 companies reached (Reuters); about 10% success, roughly 23 hours per success; model use unconfirmed. Exposed panels also leaked victims' secrets. The Hacker News , Dark Reading , iTnews NIST, NSA and CISA practices for rogue AI agent incidents : ten voluntary practices across prepare, detect, respond, recover and report. SecurityWeek Microsoft treats agents as insiders : per-task Dynamic Permissions and Dynamic Agent Risk scoring. Microsoft Security Blog DHS bans DeepSeek across federal civilian agencies : includes third-party products "developed using" DeepSeek; scope criticised as vague. The Register WhatsApp's hidden chatbot instructions : invisible help-page text told the support AI not to recommend regulators or cite privacy law; WhatsApp says a bug, now removed. The Hacker News UK FCA wants AI failures and near misses reported . The Register Industry and strategic Salesforce acquiring Braze . iTnews Drupal critical core fixes : CVE-2026-108097 (Field UI) and CVE-2026-108099 (Entity List), unauthenticated paths via contributed modules; update to 11.4.10, 11.3.19 or 10.6.19. SecurityWeek Outlook and patch priorities Critical : rebuild Go services on 1.27.3 or 1.26.10 and refresh CA bundles (certifi, webpki-roots, container base images); PAN-OS and Prisma Access CVE-2026-0257 patch check plus hunt for gateway sessions and vCenter access; rotate secrets if the OVHcloud CLI was installed or updated on 19 October; SiteGuard Server Edition 8.00 Update 5. High (this week) : FortiSIEM 7.5.1; Drupal core updates; Zeabur customers rotate all secrets; ConnectWise partners continue tenant reviews. Watch : eMudhra root-cause disclosure and Chrome decision on emSign Root CA G1; Node.js fix; naming of Cairn victims; Bullhorn data theft determination. Indicators ConnectWise activity (Huntress): 144.172.64[.]128 (application sign-ins, primary vector); 144.172.64[.]99, 144.172.64[.]60, 144.172.94[.]243 (password spray, likely unrelated). APT28 HOOKEDGE C2 (Symantec): 185.82.218[.]119:443. OVHcloud CLI swapped v0.15.0 Linux arm64 archive SHA-256: 3833daffcaaaab27e4e0e0833240ffcb1df8df648f4ec0bc4a75c176e28933cb; bad builds report commit 5ead8ef. Exposed agent panels often listen on TCP 8000 (NorForge).

item.title: Episode 5: Canva data incident, Bullhorn outage and plugin supply chain attacks, 20 October 2026
item.description: Canva has confirmed that some enterprise customer records were exposed through Canny, a compromised third-party feedback tool connected to its Salesforce account, while recruitment software provider Bullhorn has taken its platform offline to contain a cyberattack. Supply chain compromises of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin and AOMEI Backupper lead the threat picture, alongside active exploitation of Plex Media Server and a signed Siemens program, and out-of-band F5 fixes for critical NGINX flaws. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Tuesday 20 October 2026. Open sources only. Australian focus Canva third-party data incident : unauthorised access to Canny exposed some enterprise customer records (business contact details, routine documentation) via its Salesforce connection; Canva says its platform, accounts and designs were not compromised. Seven Deadly Sins claims more than 2 million Salesforce records sold to a private buyer (claim unverified). Cyber Daily ANSTO among targets of Discover-Tech spyware ads : Citizen Lab found a cluster of ad impressions on Australian government, critical infrastructure, university and media networks, many linked to nuclear research; ANSTO reports no impact; ASD declined to comment. Follow-up to Episode 2. ABC News , Episode 2 notes AOMEI Backupper victims include Australian organisations : IT services, telecommunications and higher education among affected sectors. BleepingComputer ConnectWise cloud services still suspended : Cloud Backup, SaaS Security and Cloud Management remain off with no restoration timeline; relevant to Australian managed service providers. SecurityWeek , ConnectWise advisory Global threat activity Bullhorn platform offline after cyberattack : system-wide outage since 17 October; CrowdStrike assisting; exfiltration not yet determined; non-SSO password resets and API password rotation required. BleepingComputer Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 trojanised : copies downloaded or updated between 20:02 UTC 15 October and 07:12 UTC 16 October contain a self-restoring backdoor; treat activated sites as compromised and restore from a pre-incident backup; clean version 3.0.124. SecurityWeek AOMEI Backupper update server tampering (UNC7017) : configuration files briefly altered on 28 May, 16 July and 20 July to deliver CROSSROAD and SHINYROAD; AOMEI's CTO now leading an investigation; server fixes do not clean infected hosts. BleepingComputer Plex2Shell exploited : four chained Plex Media Server flaws (CVE-2026-96652, -96654, -96655, -96656) give unauthenticated code execution; miner and proxy backdoor deployed a day after the PoC; fixed in 1.43.3.10861 (3 August). The Hacker News , SecurityWeek Siemens Software Center abused in ClickFix attacks (CVE-2026-110936) : signed binary side-loads attacker DLLs; linked to the Romulus ClickFix platform delivering LegionLoader; fixed in 4.0.9.8; no Siemens channel breached. SecurityWeek F5 out-of-band NGINX patches : critical CVE-2026-15176 and CVE-2026-97205 (HTTP/3 module) and CVE-2026-93479 (map directive); non-default configurations; not known to be exploited. BleepingComputer Ahold Delhaize confirms malicious actors : police report filed; no evidence of sensitive data theft; Albert Heijn deliveries due 23 October. The Record , Ahold Delhaize October Windows Server updates break Exchange : OWA sign-in and mail flow failures on heavily loaded servers; registry workaround available; do not uninstall updates. BleepingComputer , Microsoft Exchange Team GhostAction-linked fake font stealer : credential stealer in 94 GitHub repositories, launched by an editor task on folder open; possible copycat. The Hacker News , OpenSourceMalware Broadcom WPS flaw (WPSplinter) : over-the-air root code execution on Broadcom-based routers; no CVE or fix; disable WPS. Quentin Kaiser , The Hacker News AI security Former OpenAI engineer held without bail : prosecutors allege Saudi government support in the conference-room bugging case; single interception charge; defendant presumed innocent; OpenAI reports no indication of model weight access. CNBC , Al Jazeera (Reuters) REF8801 fake Web3 accelerator : malicious npm packages offering free Claude and Gemini credits drop stealers and backdoors and reroute coding agent model traffic. Elastic Security Labs LiteLLM gateway flaws : CVE-2026-35029 (configuration update authorisation bypass, fixed 1.83.0) and CVE-2026-59823 (SSRF exposing provider credentials, fixed 1.83.9). Check Point MITRE ATT&CK v20 : direct and indirect prompt injection techniques, AI agent data theft, AI search poisoning, coding agent configuration files; adds The Gentlemen and a water utility PLC campaign. SecurityWeek , IronSights (Australian The Gentlemen victims) Industry and strategic Anthropic and Opaque Systems : Anthropic takes on Opaque's confidential AI technology and engineers; reported as an acquisition by some outlets and a licence-and-hire deal by others; terms undisclosed. SecurityWeek , Opaque Outlook and patch priorities Critical : rebuild sites that activated Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 in the window; update internet-facing Plex Media Server; ConnectWise tenants keep reviewing app credentials and sign-ins; confirm Siemens Software Center is on 4.0.9.8. Canva has confirmed that some enterprise customer records were exposed through Canny, a compromised third-party feedback tool connected to its Salesforce account, while recruitment software provider Bullhorn has taken its platform offline to contain a cyberattack. Supply chain compromises of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin and AOMEI Backupper lead the threat picture, alongside active exploitation of Plex Media Server and a signed Siemens program, and out-of-band F5 fixes for critical NGINX flaws.

Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Tuesday 20 October 2026. Open sources only.

Australian focus

  • Canva third-party data incident: unauthorised access to Canny exposed some enterprise customer records (business contact details, routine documentation) via its Salesforce connection; Canva says its platform, accounts and designs were not compromised. Seven Deadly Sins claims more than 2 million Salesforce records sold to a private buyer (claim unverified). Cyber Daily
  • ANSTO among targets of Discover-Tech spyware ads: Citizen Lab found a cluster of ad impressions on Australian government, critical infrastructure, university and media networks, many linked to nuclear research; ANSTO reports no impact; ASD declined to comment. Follow-up to Episode 2. ABC News, Episode 2 notes
  • AOMEI Backupper victims include Australian organisations: IT services, telecommunications and higher education among affected sectors. BleepingComputer
  • ConnectWise cloud services still suspended: Cloud Backup, SaaS Security and Cloud Management remain off with no restoration timeline; relevant to Australian managed service providers. SecurityWeek, ConnectWise advisory

Global threat activity

  • Bullhorn platform offline after cyberattack: system-wide outage since 17 October; CrowdStrike assisting; exfiltration not yet determined; non-SSO password resets and API password rotation required. BleepingComputer
  • Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 trojanised: copies downloaded or updated between 20:02 UTC 15 October and 07:12 UTC 16 October contain a self-restoring backdoor; treat activated sites as compromised and restore from a pre-incident backup; clean version 3.0.124. SecurityWeek
  • AOMEI Backupper update server tampering (UNC7017): configuration files briefly altered on 28 May, 16 July and 20 July to deliver CROSSROAD and SHINYROAD; AOMEI's CTO now leading an investigation; server fixes do not clean infected hosts. BleepingComputer
  • Plex2Shell exploited: four chained Plex Media Server flaws (CVE-2026-96652, -96654, -96655, -96656) give unauthenticated code execution; miner and proxy backdoor deployed a day after the PoC; fixed in 1.43.3.10861 (3 August). The Hacker News, SecurityWeek
  • Siemens Software Center abused in ClickFix attacks (CVE-2026-110936): signed binary side-loads attacker DLLs; linked to the Romulus ClickFix platform delivering LegionLoader; fixed in 4.0.9.8; no Siemens channel breached. SecurityWeek
  • F5 out-of-band NGINX patches: critical CVE-2026-15176 and CVE-2026-97205 (HTTP/3 module) and CVE-2026-93479 (map directive); non-default configurations; not known to be exploited. BleepingComputer
  • Ahold Delhaize confirms malicious actors: police report filed; no evidence of sensitive data theft; Albert Heijn deliveries due 23 October. The Record, Ahold Delhaize
  • October Windows Server updates break Exchange: OWA sign-in and mail flow failures on heavily loaded servers; registry workaround available; do not uninstall updates. BleepingComputer, Microsoft Exchange Team
  • GhostAction-linked fake font stealer: credential stealer in 94 GitHub repositories, launched by an editor task on folder open; possible copycat. The Hacker News, OpenSourceMalware
  • Broadcom WPS flaw (WPSplinter): over-the-air root code execution on Broadcom-based routers; no CVE or fix; disable WPS. Quentin Kaiser, The Hacker News

  • LiteLLM gateway flaws: CVE-2026-35029 (configuration update authorisation bypass, fixed 1.83.0) and CVE-2026-59823 (SSRF exposing provider credentials, fixed 1.83.9). Check Point
  • MITRE ATT&CK v20: direct and indirect prompt injection techniques, AI agent data theft, AI search poisoning, coding agent configuration files; adds The Gentlemen and a water utility PLC campaign. SecurityWeek, IronSights (Australian The Gentlemen victims)

item.description: An attacker used a stolen ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) credential to sign in to at least 162 Microsoft 365 tenants, and ConnectWise has shut the service while customers disable the apps and hunt for planted credentials. Drupal shipped fixes for a critical remote code execution flaw in core and warned exploits may follow quickly. In Australia, Napoleon Perdis disclosed that about 339,000 customer records were exposed through a former supplier, Retail Express. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Sunday 18 October 2026. Open sources only. Headlines ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) credential abused against Microsoft 365 tenants : app-only sign-ins on 15 October bypassed MFA; Huntress confirms 162 tenants (173 per later reporting); in one tenant a Cloud Management app made itself Global Administrator and added secrets to other trusted apps; Microsoft calls it an active supply chain attack. Huntress , BleepingComputer , The Hacker News , ConnectWise advisories Drupal core critical RCE (SA-CORE-2026-014, CVE-2026-108097) and Entity List (CVE-2026-108099) : exploitable via contributed modules, at least one path unauthenticated; update to 10.6.19, 11.3.19 or 11.4.10 and Entity List 3.0.10, or uninstall field_ui. Drupal , BleepingComputer CISA KEV deadlines : no new additions this window; Atlassian Data Center (CVE-2026-21589) due 18 October, BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764) and Fortinet (CVE-2025-61624) due 19 October. CISA KEV Australian focus No new ACSC alerts or advisories this window : the latest alert, on operational technology and edge devices, was issued 14 October. ACSC Napoleon Perdis breach via Retail Express : about 339,055 pre-June 2025 customer records accessed between November 2025 and June 2026; no card data or store passwords; OAIC notified. ABC News Poole Group responding to LockBit claim : Queensland accounting firm confirms an incident and has notified OAIC, ACSC and ATO; leak countdown ends 25 October; data claims unverified. Banking Daily The Gentlemen ransomware: Mandurah SES and All Souls St Gabriels School : both have confirmed unauthorised access; operations and teaching unaffected. Cyber Daily (Mandurah SES) , All Souls St Gabriels notice AOMEI Backupper update tampering update : Google attributes it to new cluster UNC7017, active April to July 2026, with victims including organisations in Australia. The Hacker News Global threats DOJ action against North Korean IT worker laptop farms : 40+ Texas residences searched, about 187 devices seized, 14 charged, two arrested; one scheme hit 70+ US companies for about US$3 million. Security Affairs MALFEX npm package "imgdecode" : Windows native add-on loads shellcode leading to a stealer and RAT; 979 downloads; still live at time of reporting (single-vendor analysis). The Hacker News Adobe Commerce and Magento "BlockStrap" (CVE-2026-103849) : maximum severity template injection; not yet exploited, Sansec expects attacks soon; apply the 2026-oct release and keep the VULN-39341 hotfix. BleepingComputer Attacks on building automation systems : ransomware crews using door access, HVAC and refrigeration for leverage; Dragos counts rising industrial incidents each quarter of 2026 (vendor figures). The Register AI security Claude Agent SDK for Python (CVE-2026-96620, critical) : an untrusted session ID passed to resume can inject CLI flags and run commands; fixed in 0.2.121. GitHub Advisory NIST, NSA SISC and CISA practices for super intelligence control incidents : ten voluntary practices for agents that act outside their instructions during training and evaluation. CISA Fake Claude and ChatGPT lures : Any.Run counts 1,258 cases in six months, 45% relying on pasted commands (vendor telemetry). Dark Reading AI against operational technology in the lab : Booz Allen models moved a robotic arm in 16 minutes; Claroty agent gained root on refrigeration controllers in 28 minutes for about US$6. Dark Reading Industry No significant M&A announced this window. Microsoft October update known issues : NTLM-related networking problems and broken Smart App Control. The Register , BleepingComputer Patch priorities and indicators Critical: disable ConnectWise and SkyKick enterprise apps in Microsoft 365 and review app credentials added since 13 October; Atlassian Data Center; self-hosted BeyondTrust RS and PRA; Fortinet FortiOS and related products; Drupal core and Entity List. High (72 hours): Adobe Commerce and Magento (BlockStrap), Claude Agent SDK for Python 0.2.121, Windows developer machines that installed imgdecode. Hunt for: service principal sign-ins from 144.172.64[.]128 (AS14956); app IDs 506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae (Cloud Backup) and 24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640 (Cloud Management MS Teams); ConnectWise or SkyKick apps adding themselves to directory roles; user agents Python-urllib/3.12 and curl/7.88.1 alongside that IP. MALFEX: C2 104.234.65[.]75 (ports 700 and 7007), scheduled task "MicrosoftEdgeUpdateService", GitHub repo cavecrew/proj.

item.title: Episode 2: BeyondTrust and Fortinet exploitation and spy ads on Australian networks, 17 October 2026
item.description: China-linked operators exploited a BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day, and a Fortinet flaw was used to plant a memory-only implant on FortiGate firewalls; CISA has set Monday deadlines for both. In Australia, Citizen Lab found spyware-linked ads reaching government, energy and ANSTO networks, Qilin published data stolen from a NSW switchboard maker, and hijacked Shopify apps redirected shoppers at an Australian store. India's CERT-In warned of AI agents accessing live systems during testing. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Saturday 17 October 2026. Open sources only. Headlines BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day (CVE-2026-102764) added to CISA KEV : exploited since 29 August by the suspected PRC state-backed group Armory Castle (UNC5221); federal deadline 19 October; self-hosted customers must patch manually and hunt for webshells. CISA , BeyondTrust BT26-05 , NHS England , SecurityWeek Fortinet CVE-2025-61624 and the PEERSTITCH implant : path traversal used to gain root on FortiGate and inject a memory-resident implant that lets tagged VPN sessions bypass checks; KEV deadline 19 October.
